system.description:
Reflex Amp

Your movements leaves steaks the same color as your hair. You leave after images in your wake. Others can barely comprehend what you have become.

Seal Reproduction. You regain 1 Speed Seal at the beginning of each of your turns for the duration.

Chain Blink. You can teleport to any creature marked with your Speed Seal, once per turn. If there are multiple creatures marked with your Speed Seal, you can teleport to them each, once per turn.

Spatial Sovereign. The Sealed condition cannot prevent you from teleporting.

Spatial Immunity. You cannot be teleported against your will by any means.
system.summary: Regain a Speed Seal each turn and blink to sealed creatures. Sealed can't stop your teleports, and you can't be teleported against your will.
